about: Stand-in READMEs in our own words (see SOURCE.md). Each keeps only the finder words that mattered live.

readmes.micasa-dev/micasa:
# micasa

A terminal app for home upkeep. Keep projects, maintenance dates, appliances and vendor quotes in one file.

Build it from its Dockerfile.
readmes.cristibalan/braid:
# braid

Keeps vendor branches of other projects inside one Git repository.

## Install

```
gem install braid
```
readmes.zerodha/vendor-payments:
# vendor-payments

A Frappe app for a company paying its vendors.

## Install

```
bench get-app vendor-payments
```
readmes.example/wedding-vendors:
# wedding-vendors

Keep a wedding's vendors, quotes and bookings in one place.

## Quick start

```
npm install
npm start
```

Then open localhost:3000.
readmes.Swetrix/selfhosting:
# Swetrix, self-hosted

Collect your site's visits and look at them later on your own server.

## Quick start

```
docker compose up -d
```
readmes.pascalebeier/hitkeep:
# HitKeep

Web analytics in one program. Count visits across sites.

## Quick start

```
docker compose up -d
```

Open localhost:8080.
readmes.apache/airflow:
# Apache Airflow

Write workflows as code and run them across workers, with rate limit settings per pool.

## Docker

```
docker compose up -d
```
readmes.kestra-io/kestra:
# Kestra

Build workflows that run across many systems, with a concurrency limit per flow.

## Quick start

```

Open localhost:8080.

Switch between AI coding accounts and watch their quotas and token budgets.

```

readmes.blessyjoybj18/budget_tracker:

Record your spending and compare it with a budget, by category.

## Getting started

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

Open localhost:5000.
